lanes.semantic_interpretation: Lane can proceed straight ahead into the intersection or continuing path ahead of the sign's direction of travel (implied). This lane has a straight-ahead movement indicated by the arrow pointing straight up/forward relative to the lane's direction of travel on the sign face, which typically means straight through the intersection or continuing straight.

Lane must turn right at the intersection or continuing path ahead. This lane has a right turn movement indicated by the arrow pointing to the right relative to the lane's direction of travel on the sign face.

additional_lane_regulations: Lane 1 proceeds straight; Lane 2 turns right.
result.overall_lane_semantics: The sign indicates that the lane on the left proceeds straight while the lane on the right must turn right.
result.explanation: The sign displays two distinct arrows, one pointing straight and one pointing right, indicating separate movement instructions for the lanes.
